name: Probe Guestbook
purpose: A one-page guestbook where visitors type a short message and see the wall of messages, newest first. No accounts, no admin — open to anyone.

workflows.name: Post a message
workflows.description: Visitor types a short message (optionally a name) and submits; it appears at the top of the wall.

workflows.name: View the wall
workflows.description: The single page shows all messages, newest first.

seed_demo: A handful of welcome messages so the wall isn't empty on first load.
